exact_statement: For every finite uniform-cube Boolean sign and a fixed two-coordinate block {i,j}, under the canonical physical/spectral singleton lift, the query-order refund is R_i_then_j=I(S_j;X_i|S_remaining). For every fixed block the MU ceiling obeys B_A-J_A=2R_A+sum_h P(h)(B_h-J_h), so it is exactly the accumulated singleton MU bound. For every even k>=4, the actual B05 Boolean family F=1+A_2k(z)[b_k(x)-1-(1-y)1_{x=0}], with b_k=(-1)^(x1*x2+...), delta=2^-k and d=2^-3k, has 0<R_y_then_z1,R_z1_then_y<=32*d^2/(3 ln 2)<16*d^2. All nonempty residual Fourier packets have exactly zero refund in either order. Its selector erasure satisfies B_y>=(1-delta)(k-2)d; for even k>=6 the block MU ceiling is at least (15/32)d. Thus a single additional control-query refund cannot pay the selector logarithm at a dimension-independent price. Full terminal spectra and actual control influence remain in the ledger.
